notes.title: Demo 3 Release - Let Them Come Onslaught
notes.notes:
Check out our Brand New Trailer:
Demo 3 for Let Them Come: Onslaught is here, bringing a wave of improvements, visual upgrades, and quality-of-life changes to make your fight against the alien horde even better. 

Check out our latest trailer and see what’s new!
[previewyoutube="M-Knvt7DTWM;full"][/previewyoutube]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2050800/Let_Them_Come_Onslaught?snr=1_2108_9__2107"][/dynamiclink]Here's what's New In Demo 3:

+ Visual upgrades to the environments, new foliage, new tiles and upgrades to discover


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/220859180c76c40671e5fcafa0d4b2d87562ead5.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/1ba11a3b3366206234376e6d9976b4c6e050263b.gif"]


+ Expanded Armory with a new revamped tree


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/71389b0bbea1217eeacb576aba8eb693ee5ba512.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/233eb4d1daad29f31b2a417d3444be0df3ed9872.gif"]


+ Improved Level Up screen with better readability and a cleaner look


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/f436b95ec2e043806263cb3129b5e86361f8b44d.png"]


+ New dash cooldown for soldiers to add tactical pacing to movement


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/55d31b5661065d410c446e759c3f7e6de728fee0.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/180d10bf161015b5455b91a538e7d9dd47d113eb.gif"]


+ New Animation for Epic Crates notification to highlight big rewards


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/4cc1cf5419349287c9d7bc32670e7d6e864318b5.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/5ae55f3edb6d720fe96aac55f058e5e0e0ce5837.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/0e307ea56cad6f512b0a99980bf79ecea24180c3.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/c5b85fe1b141dd9d6b117ebf95b1e1b65aa82a85.gif"]


+ New in-game tutorial to guide first-time players through the action


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/0a32522b79f9bb771d2c20e41e5614583631354f.gif"]


Join The Discussion!


We value your feedback. Help us refine and improve the game. Whether it’s balancing suggestions, bug reports, or general thoughts on your experience, your input plays a key role in shaping future updates.

You can use the "Share Feedback" button on the main menu of the game to fill a survey about your experience.



You can also reach out to our team and chat with the Let Them Come community here on Steam forums or on our Discord server



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/8a1925cdfe267d43bdc465b52da6b00e2874da93.gif"]



Thank you for your continued support. We’re excited to show you more of what Let Them Come: Onslaught has evolved into soon, and see you all on the Crash Site!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Huge thanks to everyone trying out the Demo!

If you want to send us direct feedback about the game, be sure to take the survey either by pressing the in game Give feedback button or through this direct link


This is the list of changes with Hotfix 1:

 Added support for ultra-wide screen
 Fixed boss not moving when taking lots of damage quickly
 Added handling of keyboard locales
 Added Master Volume setting
 Fixed boss music resetting randomly during battle

Fixed optimization issues related to FPS drop when opening the armory.

 Fixed Message Events appearing above the Level Up Screen.

 Fixed issue with Supply Drop SFX
 Added impact visual effects for enemy projectiles


Make sure you join the Discord  server to chat with fellow survivors!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone that played the demo and shared their feedback with us!
We have been paying close attention to the Feedback Survey results, and to the conversations on our Steam Forum and Discord page.

Here are the updates we made to the demo.

Fewer "Manual Aiming" Weapons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/05401075e760695052229227986a0dd93b1a3dd2.gif

Reading players' feedback made us realize that we had too many "Manual Aiming" weapons in our current arsenal.

With this update, we are hoping to strike a better balance.
More weapons are now Auto-Aiming, and we are keeping one Manual Aiming weapon that expert players can still use if they want.

Let us know what you think of these changes!

Proper Options Menu

Back when we launched the demo we didn't really have time to build a proper Options Menu.
It only allowed volume control and nothing else.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/6032bb0526d4fe13314ae1f991838bf0437ae7c4.png
We are happy to announce that we now have a more fleshed out Options Menu!
This should allow you to adjust the game's settings to your liking, but it is still work in progress.
Please, feel free to let us know if you are encountering issues with this menu, or if you think some specific options are missing!

Reset Progress

For those of you that have played the demo a lot already and want to experience this update with a fresh save file, we also added the option to delete your progress in the Settings Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/b159a351a8d5be97237322ee47b147ee3a6163a3.jpg

More Improvements

We also added lots of various improvements in this update. 
- New music track in the Armory (banger!)
- Improved the visuals and sound of the lightning strikes in the level
- Performance improvements
And many other small changes.

More to Come

Now that this update is out, we will be focusing once again on creating new content for the game!
We can't wait to show you more as we get closer to our Early Access launch.

In the meantime, if you want to help us make this game as good as it can be, please keep sharing your feedback in the Feedback Survey or by making posts in the Steam Forum or our Discord.
